articles.summary: JFrog Builds a Self-healing Software Supply Chain with Broadcom, Chainguard, Echo, and Red Hat and others to answer the AI-era demand for remediation in hours JFrog Ltd . (“JFrog”) (NASDAQ: FROG), the Liquid Software company and creators of the JFrog Software Supply Chain Platform , the system of record for trusted software artifacts, binaries, and AI assets, today shared insights from a swampUP Europe security expert panel in which leaders from Broadcom , Chainguard , Echo , and Red Hat confronted a shared problem: “the patching gap” . Their unanimous conclusion: organizations can no longer rely on manual vulnerability triage and patching. Resilience in the AI era depends on three key elements: a single source of truth where every artifact lives; an ecosystem of patching vendors producing fixes faster than disclosure; and a self-healing software supply chain that enables continuous, zero-touch remediation at the speed of the threat.
